summary: The Knock was a British television crime drama created by Anita Bronson and broadcast on ITV. It followed customs officers from the London City & South Collection Investigation Unit of HM Customs and Excise. The title came from the distinctive "Knock knock knock" radio command used to synchronise a raid.
one_line: The Knock was an ITV crime drama created by Anita Bronson about customs officers in HM Customs and Excise's London investigation unit.
key_facts: The Knock was a British television crime drama.
The Knock was created by Anita Bronson.
The Knock was broadcast on ITV.
The Knock portrayed the activities of customs officers from the London City & South Collection Investigation Unit of HM Customs and Excise.
The series derived its name from the distinctive "Knock knock knock" command used over the radio to synchronise a raid.
